text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: You're in quite a good mood.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, since I had some time off, I went to
a local farmer's market, but—

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I happened to run into Nature-san and Ikuno-san by chance, and we went shopping together.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Selecting the fresh bounty of the earth together,
and cooking and eating it together...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, even with all the bustle,
it felt warm and peaceful like a sunny spot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing Yamanin Zephyr looking as if she had spent
a thoroughly fulfilling day off
warmed my heart as well.
